fact: The diagnostic reports that CEMAC regional regulations N°03/16/CEMAC/UMAC/CM and N°04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/CM/COBAC govern e-money issuance and payment service providers in the CEMAC zone, of which Chad is a member, and that CEMAC telecom regulators have issued e-signature legislation but not Chad.
title: Chad DE4A Country Diagnostic (P177120)
